enchantments.tooltip: Quality Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +22 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Legendary Accuracy +6: Passive: +6 Legendary bonus to attack rolls
Legendary Deadly +3: +3 Legendary bonus to weapon damage.
